findings.issue: The completion claim is unsupported because the audit reports `DISPATCH FAILED`, has `audit_status: blocked`, records no successful validation, and F008 remains `passes: false`; rerun implementation and produce a successful audit with passing tests.

Configured non-lifecycle gates can be pre-cleared while not pending; the pending check applies only to lifecycle gates, and a probe returned `approved on_escalation`; require every bridge-approved gate to be declared and currently pending.

Allowlist dimensions fail open because an empty `gate_kinds` list expands to `pre_impl` and `pre_merge`, while an omitted channel accepts approvals from any channel; reject empty/malformed gate kinds and require an explicit channel when enabled.

Agent exclusion is not authoritative because `agent_pubkeys: []` enables the bridge, allowing an agent key placed only in `approver_pubkeys` to be treated as human; require reliable identity classification for Tier-3 approval.

`GETTING_STARTED.md` describes reaction-relayed approvals and caller-provided `sig_verified: true`, while the implementation rejects both and requires a raw signed event; document the actual signed ceremony.
Ruff reports two E501 violations in the F008 test file at lines 115 and 226; wrap those signatures.

The implementer audit incorrectly claims `Env: dev` is missing even though it is present; remove the spurious finding.
